description: Source code implementing Vulkan-based pooling operations (adaptive_avg_pool2d, pool2d, avg_pool2d, max_pool2d) for PyTorch, including kernel submission and shape checks.

methods.name: adaptive_avg_pool2d
methods.description: Performs 2D adaptive average pooling on Vulkan tensors, submitting compute jobs to Vulkan API.

methods.name: pool2d
methods.description: Performs 2D pooling (average or max) with specified kernel, stride, padding, dilation, and ceil mode, submitting compute jobs to Vulkan API.

methods.name: avg_pool2d
methods.description: Wrapper for pool2d to perform average pooling.

methods.name: max_pool2d
methods.description: Wrapper for pool2d to perform max pooling, handling quantized types.
